topic: Research methods for teachers' perceptions of digital tools in geography

Q1.comment: The supervisor had a good understanding of my concerns but could have probed more deeply into specific areas.

Q2.comment: Questions and guidance were well-calibrated to my level and helped me articulate my thoughts clearly.

Q3.comment: I felt completely safe expressing uncertainty without embarrassment.

Q4.comment: The conversation was efficient but could have been slightly more streamlined in some areas.

Q5.comment: Overall, I am very satisfied with this supervisory interaction. It helped me clarify my thoughts and approach to the research question.

Q_open.comment: The most helpful thing was having a clear explanation of how semi-structured interviews align with an exploratory and interpretivist research design. It could have been better if we had more time to explore potential limitations in detail.

task_check.evidence: I think semi-structured interviews will help me understand teachers' perceptions deeply and in context. The flexibility allows for rich data, and I can follow up on interesting responses.
